answer: Signed-camera scene proofs. Each epoch the seed names a scene: a ferrous bolt, a timber offcut and a jade-colored card bearing the key's 6-digit nonce, shot within 30 minutes on a phone whose camera chip signs C2PA content credentials. One device certificate backs one seat; a repeated serial, or backgrounds over 0.9 similar across keys, merges the seats. Each fake then needs a ~$300 signing phone and two minutes of hands-on staging every epoch: 100 aliases cost $30k plus ~13 hours of human labor a day. Rooted phones are caught by maker revocation lists.
